auditName: Figma-to-Staging Mobile PDP Design Parity Audit (390×844px Visual Audit)

whyPreviousAuditFailed: The previous audit only checked if computedStyle.fontFamily contained "outfit" without comparing rendered font weights, sizes, line heights, or glyph appearance.
Figma uses 8 distinct font families (Outfit, Urbanist, Oi, Montserrat, Inter, Khand, Average Sans, Vi), but staging only loads Outfit and Jost, causing visual fallbacks.
The previous audit performed shallow DOM property assertions rather than pixel-accurate visual comparisons against normalized Figma reference frames.
Product title weight mismatch (Figma Medium 500 vs Staging Bold 700) was masked as a PASS by string-matching "outfit".
Price hierarchy font size mismatch (Figma 20px headline vs Staging 15px) was not evaluated against visual hierarchy tokens.

complianceVerdict.verdictStatus: PARTIAL — Minor Design Parity Gaps Remain
complianceVerdict.summary: Visual re-audit identified 7 genuine mobile typography & layout mismatches and 5 missing decorative micro-icons.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Product Title Typography Weight & Semantic Tag Mismatch on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Font: Outfit Medium (500), Size: 16px, Line-height: 18px, Tag: <h1>, Color: #111111
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Font weight is Bold (700) instead of Medium (500); rendered size is 17px with 23.38px line height; tag is <h2> instead of <h1>
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Change title class from text-[17px] font-bold to text-[16px] font-medium leading-[18px] and use <h1> semantic heading.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Search Bar Placeholder Typography & Color Mismatch on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Font: Outfit Regular (400), Size: 14px, Line-height: 20px, Color: #6B7280 (#9B9FB3 in placeholder)
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Font weight rendered as Medium (500) instead of Regular (400)
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Set font-weight to 400 (font-normal) on search bar text span.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Special Price Typography Hierarchy Mismatch on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Offer Price: Outfit Bold (700) 20px/24px #111111; Strike MRP: Outfit Regular 12px #7A83A1
confirmedMobileMismatches.expected: font-size: 20px, font-weight: 700 for main special price
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Main discounted price rendered at 15px font size instead of 20px hierarchy headline
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Scale primary price display to text-[20px] font-bold text-[#111111] to match Figma visual prominence.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Mobile Header Search Bar Width & Padding Asymmetry
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Search bar width: 342px centered with 24px left/right margins, height: 44px, full rounded pill
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Search bar is narrower (254px vs 342px) due to asymmetrical absolute spacing on header row
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Expand search input container to full width flex-grow with standard 16px horizontal container padding.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Promotional "woohoo !" Badge Font Family Fallback on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.expected: Font family: Oi with distinctive display serif styling
confirmedMobileMismatches.actual: Font family: Outfit (Fallback to standard sans-serif)
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Staging does not load the "Oi" font file, resulting in generic sans-serif rendering for promotional badges
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Import Google Font "Oi" in Next.js font configuration for promotional coupon badges or align Figma to Outfit.

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Sticky Purchase Action Buttons Font Weight Mismatch on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Add to Cart & Buy Now: Outfit Medium (500) / SemiBold (600), font-size: 14px, letter-spacing: normal
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Button text rendered as heavy Bold (700) rather than Figma SemiBold (600)
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Adjust sticky CTA button class from font-bold to font-semibold (600).

confirmedMobileMismatches.title: Bank Offers Card Horizontal Padding & Margin Mismatch on Mobile
confirmedMobileMismatches.figmaRequirement: Card width: 160px with 12px gap in horizontal scroll container, border: 1px solid #E5E7EB, border-radius: 12px
confirmedMobileMismatches.difference: Card width is 134px with 10px radius instead of 160px width with 12px radius
confirmedMobileMismatches.developerAction: Update bank offer item dimensions to min-w-[160px] rounded-[12px].

missingMobileIcons.expectedElement: Visual camera search icon button in mobile search bar
missingMobileIcons.reasonForAbsence: Mobile header search bar does not implement visual camera search CTA.

missingMobileIcons.expectedElement: Voice microphone search icon button in mobile search bar
missingMobileIcons.reasonForAbsence: Mobile header search bar does not implement voice search icon.
Mobile PDP omits top breadcrumb row to maximize vertical screen space.

missingMobileIcons.expectedElement: Video review play badge overlay on thumbnail
missingMobileIcons.reasonForAbsence: Staging gallery renders static catalog images without video overlay badges.
Renders CSS text pill badges without SVG discount shape.
